items.summary: The FCC plans to open 1,050 MHz in the 12.7 GHz and 42 GHz bands to expanded satellite use, adding capacity for broadband, mobile connectivity, inter-satellite links and ground networks.

items.title: IEEE CSCN 2026 Workshop Explores How 6G Can Empower Polyfunctional Robotics

items.title: 4iG and SpaceX Plan Starlink Mobile Rollout Across Hungary and Western Balkans
items.summary: 4iG and SpaceX plan direct-to-device Starlink services across four European markets, alongside secured government communications, but national spectrum approvals and key details of the proposed sovereign infrastructure remain unresolved.

items.title: Starlink’s Unconventional Approach to Cellular
items.summary: SpaceX is considering a terrestrial cellular network powered by Starlink satellite backhaul, but scarce spectrum, enormous capacity demands and entrenched rivals could make its boldest telecommunications gambit yet far harder to execute profitably at scale.

items.title: Wi-Fi 7 Adoption Is Accelerating
items.summary: Wi-Fi 7 is spreading rapidly across America, promising faster speeds, greater capacity and fewer connectivity headaches. With big internet providers driving adoption, the technology is reshaping home broadband even as Wi-Fi 8 approaches.

items.title: How operators plan to turn AI into network performance and new revenue
items.summary: A new Fierce Network Research report explores how AT&T, T-Mobile, Nokia, SoftBank and Nvidia are approaching AI-RAN, and what it could mean for network efficiency, spectrum utilization and future business models.

items.title: Opinion: America's private 5G opportunity is hiding in shared spectrum
items.summary: Manufacturers need regulatory certainty, not subsidies, to control their own private wireless networks, says John Puskar of the American Made 5G Coalition.

items.title: Charter’s AI strategy starts with reliability: Spectrum bets on network resilience as edge computing grows
items.summary: At SCTE TechExpo26, Charter's leaders outlined how Spectrum is expanding edge computing capabilities while emphasizing that AI's most immediate value may be in improving network operations and service availability.

items.title: Starlink Mobile’s $25B threat looms over US carriers
items.summary: A Besen Group analysis projects Starlink Mobile’s U.S. revenue will hit $25.35 billion by 2031, positioning it as both a formidable carrier rival and potential partner.

items.title: Vistance touts 50G PON, AI operations and DOCSIS 4.0 momentum
items.summary: Fresh off major DOCSIS 4.0 milestones with Ziggo and Comcast, Vistance Networks' Aurora Networks business used SCTE TechExpo26 to spotlight new 50G PON hardware, AI-powered network operations and software.

items.title: Satellites score abundance of spectrum in FCC’s latest move
items.summary: The FCC is giving another big boost to satellites by bringing thousands of megahertz of spectrum to market.

items.title: Charter Spectrum wraps rural expansion in Somerset County, Maryland
items.summary: It connected more than 1,300 homes as part of a multi-year initiative.

items.title: Corning bags $3B fiber supply deal with AT&T
items.summary: Corning just landed another mega fiber deal — this time with AT&T, which is racing to double its U.S. fiber footprint by 2030.

items.title: EU taps Orange Business for sovereign comms backbone
items.summary: Orange Business will help the EU build a secure, sovereign backbone for government communications as cyber threats mount.

items.title: Opinion: Samsung gets the AI infrastructure deal right
items.summary: Samsung’s $1 billion Helix commitment puts its industrial capabilities into the right market.

items.title: It’s T-Mobile Tuesday, so … another price hike?
items.summary: T-Mobile is raising regulatory fees for most postpaid customers, risking further customer frustration over expanding “junk fees.”
